frames.label: Set up
frames.note: Compare the starting stance with the ball position in the video.

frames.label: Sell the move
frames.note: Look at the lean of the upper body as the player approaches the ball.

frames.label: Step across
frames.note: Inspect the stepping foot and the supporting knee from the side.

frames.label: Shift weight
frames.note: This is the second tutorial take. Compare the hip position with the planted foot.

frames.label: Change direction
frames.note: Use the side view to inspect knee bend as the body turns.

frames.label: Accelerate away
frames.note: Look at the push-off and torso angle. Revisit the video to see the ball's path.
